name: Sat Lab
desc: A Keplerian orbit simulator: semi-major axis, eccentricity and inclination sliders drive the period, apoapsis/periapsis velocities and a live ground track.
controls: Semi-major axis, eccentricity, inclination and time-scale sliders, five orbit presets (LEO, ISS, GEO, Molniya, GTO), play/pause and ground-track toggles; keys 1–5 load presets, Space pauses, T toggles the track
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
